visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a white t-shirt holds a white box of fried food against a plain white wall. He smiles excitedly at the camera. (2) He pours a large quantity of fried chicken into a large white porcelain bowl on a reflective metal table. He then shows a long green scallion and a small plate of sliced white onions and garlic cloves. (3) He pours a golden-yellow beverage from a can into a large glass mug filled with ice; white foam rapidly rises to the brim. (4) The man uses chopsticks to pick up a piece of crispy chicken skin and eats it with a satisfied expression. (5) A smartphone screen is shown, displaying an 'AI Event Notification' interface for 'Hami Cam,' featuring camera monitoring zones. (6) A young woman with long brown hair wearing a denim shirt appears in the same indoor setting, picking up a piece of chicken with chopsticks and eating. (7) The man returns, showing the camera's ability to detect pets (cats) and strangers through a digital interface recording. (8) He sits on a grey sofa, holding his phone and speaking directly to the camera in a professional manner. (9) An older man with grey hair briefly appears at the table, eating from the bowl while the main character is away.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat electronic pop music starts. A male voice speaks with high enthusiasm and rapid speech rate. (2) Heavy percussive crunching SFX and rustling sounds dominate as food is moved. Followed immediately by a distinct, bright liquid pouring sound with fizzy, high-frequency bubbling textures. (3) A loud, wet gulping sound is heard, followed by a sharp, satisfied exhale ('Ah!'). (4) Aggressive, close-mic crunching SFX (ASMR-style) occurs during eating phases, paired with high-pitched 'Ding' and cartoonish 'Pop' sound effects. (5) A clean digital notification chime triggers a shift in the narration tone to a more explanatory, tech-focused pitch. (6) Whistling-based light comedic music replaces the main theme during a middle segment featuring a female voice. (7) Main electronic theme returns with rapid-fire narration detailing technical specs, accompanied by 'Whoosh' transition effects.
